references.text: Describes Israel's victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and the conquest of their land.
Moses gave the kingdoms of Sihon and Og as an inheritance to the tribe of Gad, the tribe of Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
Parallel text describing the distribution of the conquered land to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
Summarizes the territories east of the Jordan that Israel conquered and distributed among the tribes.
Confirms that Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh received their inheritance east of the Jordan, given by Moses.
Joshua sends the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh back to their allotted lands east of the Jordan.
